description: Fetch one story by (issue slug, story id). The story id is the kebab-case slug stored on each story (e.g. "grok-build", "shai-hulud-2"). Returns the story tree including body paragraphs, feature card, image, and source citations. No auth required. Args: { slug: string, story_id: string }.
name: ic_signal_get_story
title: Get a single SIGNAL story (public)
